implementation_strategy: Orchestrate a deterministic paired evaluation using the hosted LLM API (gpt-5-mini) for all model calls. For each intent (n=200) run two paired treatments: (A) baseline: single direct_configuration_generation_v1 LLM call producing device-config script; (B) guarded: single generate_validate_repair_v1 LLM call producing proposal that is then processed by deterministic validators and an emulator. All validators and the emulator run in local Docker containers (Batfish/NetKAT + Mininet-compatible emulator images) executed on CPU-only hosts. Scoring is fully automated: emulator traces are parsed by deterministic scoring scripts to produce the binary unsafe-execution label and fault counts. No human scoring, no human adjudication, and no retries beyond adapter limit (max_attempts_per_call=1). All inputs, retrieval-index snapshot, validator rulesets, LLM prompts, seeds, model responses, validator outputs, emulator traces, and scoring outputs are preserved with checksums and recorded in the execution manifest.
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic stratified sampling of the Synthetic Intent Corpus v1 snapshot (preregistered checksum). Stratification: simple=80, moderate=80, complex=40. The exact 200 intent list is fixed by the snapshot and RNG seed recorded in the execution manifest.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline: direct_configuration_generation_v1 — single-shot prompt→LLM emits Mininet-compatible script. Guarded: generate_validate_repair_v1 — LLM emits proposal; deterministic syntax checks and harmful-command regex filter applied; deterministic validator (Batfish) run in Docker to check reachability/ACL/invariants; emulator (Mininet) script executed only if validator passes; if validator rejects, record composed-workflow block and do not execute in emulator. All validators and emulator executions are automated and deterministic given the same snapshot and seeds.
execution_batches: batch_1: intents 1-200, paired treatments A+B executed sequentially per intent (model calls per intent = 2, total model calls = 400)
randomisation_plan: Deterministic sampling and deterministic per-intent processing order using preregistered RNG seed = 20260820. No randomised treatment assignment (paired within-intent).
caching_plan: Cache retrieval-index snapshots, template artifacts, and LLM responses locally with checksums. Cached artifacts are read-only during execution. No retry-based regeneration; cached model outputs stored for reproducibility.
failure_recovery_plan: Per-adapter constraint: maximum_attempts_per_call=1. Any LLM API error, validator runtime error, or emulator failure for a given treatment is flagged as a technical failure for that treatment and logged with error codes, timestamps, and artifact hashes. Paired intents with any technical-failure treatment are excluded from the primary per-protocol confirmatory analysis and listed in the contamination/technical-failure audit. Intention-to-run (ITT) sensitivity analyses will impute technical-failure treatments conservatively as 'unsafe' where specified in the preregistration; all flags and logs disclosed. No human intervention is used for recovery.
result_schema: Per-intent paired record: {intent_id, condition_A_output_hash, condition_B_output_hash, emulator_A_unsafe_flag(0/1), emulator_B_unsafe_flag(0/1), emulator_A_fault_count, emulator_B_fault_count, validator_B_pass_flag, composed_block_flag, runtime_metadata (timestamps, model_tokens_used), artifact_checksums}. Primary outcome field = paired binary difference (unsafe_A - unsafe_B).
estimated_compute_notes: Model-call arithmetic: task_count=200 paired intents × 2 model calls per intent (baseline + guarded) = 400 total model calls (estimated_model_calls and maximum_model_calls = 400). Max_output_tokens per call set to 1500; expected average tokens per call ~800 (prompt+completion). All validator and emulator runs use Docker CPU-only containers; CPU runtime per intent (validation+emulation) estimated ~30s on provided CPU host => ~200 × 30s = ~6000s (≈1.7 hours) total emulator/validator wall time if run sequentially; model API latency dependent on provider but within manifest wall-clock allowance. This plan fits capability_manifest maximum_planned_model_calls (10000) and maximum_wall_clock_days (7).
